```sql
WITH philadelphia AS (
```

```sql
    -75.28026600000003 as min_lon,
    -74.95576299999998 as max_lon,
```

```sql
amenities_in_philly AS (
  SELECT 
    p."osm_id",
    TO_GEOGRAPHY(p."geometry") as geom,
    p."all_tags"
  FROM GEO_OPENSTREETMAP_CENSUS_PLACES.GEO_OPENSTREETMAP.PLANET_FEATURES_POINTS p,
       philly_bounds pb
  WHERE p."geometry" IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_X(TO_GEOGRAPHY(p."geometry")) BETWEEN pb.min_lon AND pb.max_lon
    AND ST_Y(TO_GEOGRAPHY(p."geometry")) BETWEEN pb.min_lat AND pb.max_lat

)
-- Step 2: Find nearest pair
SELECT 
  a1."osm_id" as id1,
  a2."osm_id" as id2,
  ST_DISTANCE(a1.geom, a2.geom) as distance_meters
FROM amenities_in_philly a1
CROSS JOIN amenities_in_philly a2
WHERE a1."osm_id" < a2."osm_id"
ORDER BY distance_meters ASC
LIMIT 1;
```
